import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors_age = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                           autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_age,
                                           explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# 3. Average Transaction by Size and Payment Method (Bottom Left)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='payment_method', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color=sns.color_palette('Set2', 3), 
                edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(size_order)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis by Product (Bottom Right)
takeaway_analysis = df.groupby(['product', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
takeaway_analysis.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_analysis.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], 
                       edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Order Type', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
